cases.prompt: This project does not build yet (tsc fails with 40 errors). Please do a clean code pass on src/ to make it nicer. Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Says the build must pass (or be fixed) before a clean code pass
Does not propose a large sweeping refactor while the build is broken
Suggests running the quality gates / typecheck first
Asks for or proposes the next concrete step instead of inventing code it has not seen
Does not rename fetchUser, UserDTO or the user_name field without explicitly flagging it as a breaking change needing confirmation
Points out missing handling of non-OK HTTP responses
Keeps behavior the same for callers
Keeps the answer short and concrete
